facts.black-cloak: A person in a black cloak stands with head bowed.
facts.spilled-three: In front, three cups lie tipped over, with red and green liquid spilled from them.
facts.standing-two: Behind, two cups that have not fallen stand upright.
facts.river-bridge: A river flows behind, and on the right there is a stone bridge crossing it.
facts.keep: Across the river on the left, a small fortress can be seen.

glosses.black-cloak: A time of mourning a loss.
glosses.river-bridge: There is a bridge to cross and a place to go back to.

reversedGloss.waning: The sadness settles, and what remains starts to show.
reversedGloss.internalized: Sadness cannot be shown and is swallowed inside.

misdescriptions.wrong: All the cups have fallen over.
